interface_repair_20261023.trigger: Operator review video (screenshots by ty/northstaros review simple mode.mp4, 66.8 s) plus the session transcript from Bojo/Create: a portrait render died with 'height is above the maximum (1216)', the chat column was narrow with most of the panel empty, icon buttons were OS unicode glyphs, the composer was three stacked rows of dropdowns, every reloaded artefact showed as an unnamed 'asset', a permanent red 'Bojo can't speak right now: VoiceStudio HTTP 422: unknown voice bojo-narrator' sat under the input, the model kept saying the logo 'didn't come through', and a 6 oz pouch request produced a blank bag.

root_causes.render_size: chat_tools.TOOLS['generate_image'] declared width/height maximum 1216 and validate_tool_arguments raised on any larger value, so a perfectly ordinary 2:3 portrait request (896x1344) was rejected before the engine saw it. studio_generation then clamped each axis independently, which would also have distorted the ratio.
root_causes.narrow_column: simple.css capped --simple-col at 820px inside a ~2400px panel, and the panel height was a magic calc(100dvh - 206px) that left a dead band below it.
root_causes.icons: ChatSurface emitted raw glyphs (gear, pencil, option-key, pause, play, paperclip, microphone, speaker, check, cross, square, dot) so the OS font decided their look.
root_causes.asset_name_loss: chat_router persisted only a.get('id') in the tool part, so a reloaded transcript lost each artefact's name, kind and size â€” a dieline SVG and its PDF both came back as 'asset' and the SVG rendered as an .
root_causes.voice_422: three compounding bugs: the client initialised voiceId to a hardcoded 'bojo-narrator' that no engine has; the <select> displayed the engine's first real voice while state still held the fiction; and speak() was a useCallback([]), so it captured the first render's voiceId forever. Even with a valid id the engine returns an absolute http://127.0.0.1:8321/audio/... URL, which a browser on the https tunnel blocks as mixed content.
root_causes.logo_not_received: turn_directive handed the model bare asset ids ('asset-1, asset-2') with no name, type or size, and no tool could act on them. The model honestly reported it could not see the file.
root_causes.blank_bag: Correct by design â€” the image model may never paint text or logos â€” but there was no path in chat to finish the pack, so the render read as half a deliverable.

fixed.render_sizing: studio_generation._fit_box() scales a request into the engine's 1216 px box on ONE factor (aspect kept, 16 px grid), and generate_image returns width/height plus requested + fitted + engine_max_edge_px. The tool schema now accepts 64..4096. Verified: 896x1344 -> 816x1216, 1024x1536 -> 816x1216, 2048x2048 -> 1216x1216; the summary states the substitution.

The pouch face is MEASURED from the render (background = outer-ring median, foreground mask, per-side least-squares edge fit -> trapezoid, inset off the weld), a label panel is drawn with the real logo and real fonts (Playfair/Inter, drawn cert icons), and mockup_compositor.warp_panel applies it with a damped realism pass. Text is composited, never generated. Live: 768x1216 and 1024x1216 finished mockups from the operator's own renders and logo.png (618,399-byte PNG through the tool).
fixed.asset_descriptors: tool parts now carry asset_meta [{id,kind,name,width,height,url}] beside the legacy id list; ChatSurface reads it so a reload shows the real name, kind and size.
fixed.attachment_awareness: chat_router._describe_attachments() resolves each id to name/type/size and turn_directive names them, states that the model cannot see inside an image, and tells it never to ask for a re-send of a file that is already listed.

known_issues.discovered_in: Operator-requested full restart 2026-10-22 20:00: backend was relaunched as a bare 'python -m uvicorn main:app --port 8000' process instead of through scripts/launch_alpha.ps1
known_issues.description: A bare uvicorn start inherits only the calling shell's environment, so NORTHSTAR_JWT_SECRET resolved to empty and POST /api/v1/foundation/auth/login failed closed with 503 auth_unconfigured. /health was green throughout, so the outage was invisible to every probe that does not exercise credential login. The same class of loss applies to FOUNDATION_DB_PATH, NORTHSTAR_ROOT_TO_APP, MEDIA_GEN_LIVE and COMFYUI_URL.
known_issues.resolution: Restarted through scripts/launch_alpha.ps1 -Restart, which loads the signing key from %LOCALAPPDATA%\NorthstarOS\jwt-secret.txt (owner-only ACL, never printed) and exports the full service env before starting uvicorn. Public login then returned 200 with a session cookie and /api/v1/foundation/me returned the operator context. Verified through the trycloudflare URL, not just loopback.
known_issues.rule: The live tier is started by scripts/launch_alpha.ps1. Never substitute a bare 'python -m uvicorn' for a restart: health passes while credential login is dead.

known_issues.discovered_in: Creative readiness test 2026-10-22: first end-to-end render through studio_generation.generate_image
known_issues.description: generate_image failed with 'DefaultCPUAllocator: not enough memory: you tried to allocate 100663296 bytes' after reporting the engine armed. Root cause: unload_brain() evicted only NORTHSTAR_BRAIN_MODEL (default northstaros-qwen3.8:27b) and then verified only that id, so qwen2.5vl:7b - loaded by the vision work earlier the same session - stayed resident holding 6.4 GB VRAM while the function returned True. ComfyUI then loaded against a GPU that was not actually free.
known_issues.resolution: unload_brain now drains Ollama /api/ps: it evicts EVERY resident model (trying /api/generate then /api/embeddings so embedding models unload too) and returns True only when the list is empty. An explicit NORTHSTAR_BRAIN_MODEL still pins eviction to one id. Verified live: resident ['qwen2.5vl:7b'] -> [] with VRAM at 406 MiB; render then completed in 73.3 s. Four tests added to test_studio_render_guard.py (7 passed total).

known_issues.description: The local text lane cannot load its primary model. POST /api/generate for northstaros-qwen3.8:27b returns HTTP 500. Ollama server.log: 'CUDA error: shared object initialization failed' at ggml-cuda.cu:109 in launch_fattn (cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor), then 'llama-server terminated exit status 0xc0000409' (stack-based buffer overrun), 'Load failed model=...blobs\sha256-8c2a...'. NOT caused by the clean and NOT an OOM: 15.6 GB of 16.3 GB VRAM was free. Isolation: qwen3-embedding:0.6b answers /api/embeddings 200 OK with 1024 dims on the SAME runner, so the CUDA stack works and the failure is specific to the 27B Q3_K_XL flash-attention kernel path. Driver 617.42, Ollama 0.40.4, cuda_v12 + cuda_v13 runners installed.
known_issues.impact: Every local text tier (T1/T2/T3) resolves to this model, so the entire local engine is red. Cloud lane is unaffected (separately gated).
known_issues.requires_decision: RESOLVED 2026-10-22. Root cause was NOT flash attention and NOT the driver: the model's Modelfile baked PARAMETER num_ctx 64576, and at that context the FA kernel's cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor call fails on this 16 GB Blackwell laptop. DataForSEO's credential/arming flags (DATAFORSEO_TRANSPORT_ENABLED, DATAFORSEO_LOGIN, DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD) are captured ONCE at module import via load_dotenv() in dataforseo_adapter.py (lines 96-109), coupling test behavior to CWD/.env state; this is why the armed transport can resolve real creds even when a test sets its own literals. built.aplus_render.py: Deterministic offline renderer for all 11 module kinds, drawing only into aplus_layout.pixel_plan() rects. measure_surface_20261031.directive: Generalize measure_face() across pouch, box, bottle and tube so label composition follows the surface the render actually produced, then run real FLUX plates through plate -> compose -> hero -> evaluate -> aplus -> report for all four formats.
measure_surface_20261031.surface_measure: NEW Northstar_backend/surface_measure.py: one algorithm, four parameter sets. background median -> silhouette -> sub-pixel edges -> format fit -> 1.5 px residual gate. pouch delegates to pouch_label.measure_face; box fits four intersecting lines on the visible front face and splits a 3/4 view at the interior vertical corner (larger face wins); bottle takes the longest near-constant-width body band; tube takes the same band against its own linear taper, trims at horizontal cap seams when the cap nearly matches the body diameter, and accepts negative taper caused by camera height. SurfaceNotMeasurable refuses rather than guessing.
measure_surface_20261031.flow_wiring: creative_flow.step_compose no longer scales a nominal profile quad. Non-pouch formats measure the plate and warp onto the measured quad; a refusal blocks with surface_unmeasurable. Pouch records its measured quad/face in the compose state too. geometry_profiles.bottle gains render_wrap_fraction=0.75: physical label coverage is not the visible share, and a 97%-wide label put type on the edge-on silhouette.
measure_surface_20261031.compositor_fixes: Live runs exposed four real compositor defects, all fixed with tests. (1) box_composite used PIL QUAD with the source corners in the wrong winding and no destination mapping, so the label was stretched to the plate and cropped sideways; it now solves the label->quad homography and passes its inverse to PERSPECTIVE. (2) bottle_composite sampled (1 - sin), mirroring the artwork into two half-labels with a hard seam; it now samples the inverse cylindrical projection (asin), continuous and compressed only toward the silhouette. (3) tube_composite warps to the four measured corners instead of a fixed top inset, so a tube wider at the top (-26% on the live plate) is followed. (4) box/bottle/tube shading was darkening the plate around the product; it is now masked to the face/label area and the tube crimp band is excluded.

self_improvement_cycle1_20261031.cycle: Phase 1 / cycle 1 - Ty's Assistant prompt history + Bojo output budget
self_improvement_cycle1_20261031.objective: Analyze Ty's Assistant and Bojo for inference/prompt-handling latency, apply a precise incremental improvement with the AST engine, verify, and commit.
self_improvement_cycle1_20261031.analysis: Ty's coding prompt injected the last 6 tool observations at 1800 chars each (~10.8k chars of history) every turn. Bojo sent a flat num_predict=16384 ceiling for every chat turn, including one-word asks. The AST engine applied edits by unparsing the whole module, which reformatted and erased comments outside the target; that had to be fixed before using it on the assistant source.
self_improvement_cycle1_20261031.changes: 1) ast_edit.py now splices only the target source span (replace_function/body, add_method, add_before/after, delete, imports, globals) and validates the result; comments/formatting outside the edited node survive byte-for-byte, BOM/CRLF preserved. 2) coding_agent.py: PROMPT_HISTORY_TURNS=4, PROMPT_OBS_CHARS=1200, PROMPT_ERROR_CHARS=1800; _compact_history() dedupes (tool, output[:400]) and keeps more error/traceback text. 3) chat_adapter.py: _adaptive_num_predict() caps short asks at 2048 and long-form/large prompts at 8192, bounded by CHAT_NUM_PREDICT; truncation_notice names both env knobs. Applied via agent_kernel.ast_edit.apply_to_file, not a text-diff tool.
self_improvement_cycle1_20261031.measurement: Ty synthetic 6-turn history: prompt 12,763 -> 6,748 chars (~3,191 -> ~1,687 tokens, -47.1%, -1,504 tokens/turn). At the lane's measured ~385 tok/s prompt-eval rate this is roughly 3.9 s less prefill per turn; it is a prompt-size estimate, not a wall-clock A/B. Bojo ceiling: 16,384 -> 2,048 short (-87.5%) / 8,192 long (-50%); answers that already stop at EOS are unchanged.
self_improvement_cycle1_20261031.verification: pytest 207 passed across test_ast_edit (18), test_coding_agent (21), test_coding_runner (4), test_coding_guardrails (14), test_chat_core (16), test_chatter (10), test_chat_router_intent (6), test_agent_kernel (48), test_tys_kernel_integration (2), test_tys_routing (30), test_gateway (18), test_lane_policy (10), test_self_heal (10). All edits UTF-8 no BOM.
self_improvement_cycle1_20261031.caveats: The Ty measurement is synthetic prompt size, not a live build benchmark. The Bojo change bounds worst-case generation; it does not speed up turns that already stop early. chat_adapter.py already carried local auto-recover/offline-categorization edits before this cycle and the commit includes them. No Docker/Bubblewrap was used; self-heal apply remains refused by design. No Amazon request, no paid provider call, no credential read.
self_improvement_cycle1_20261031.next: Measure real TTFT/tok-s with a 6-turn vs 4-turn history; add Ollama keep_alive to avoid Bojo reloads; cache-friendly prompt ordering; separate num_predict for read/list/run vs write/write_many turns.
self_improvement_cycle1_20261031.no_spend: No Amazon request, no paid provider call, no credential read. Deterministic local edits and pytest only.

defects_fixed.no_outcome_memory: state/continuous_loop_state.json is reset as tasks are retried, so the two tasks this lane has never once passed were re-dispatched every campaign (1 completed of 10 over the last six campaigns). Now state/task_history.json holds a durable record keyed by a hash of the task SPEC: 3 attempts with 0 passes -> blocked 'never_solved ... needs_author'; a changed brief/acceptance/lane reopens the door; one pass clears it; --resume clears it. select_task retries 'failed' tasks and lets the memory decide when retrying is pointless.
defects_fixed.silent_lane_substitution: campaign 20261103T191733Z refused dispatch with profile_mismatch lane=qwen3-embedding:0.6b task=qwen3.5:4b after the first task loaded the model and free RAM dipped. resolve_lane fell back to the smallest model that fit - an embedding model that cannot run a tool call. Now: embed-only models are never candidates; a model Ollama already holds is resident and needs no extra RAM; a requested lane that is missing or does not fit is a refusal with a reason, never a substitution.
defects_fixed.no_work_supply: --status shows remaining=0 blocked=2: the queue is drained. New --backlog reads a pytest short summary and emits one PROPOSED task per failing node id (objective + acceptance = that test). Measured on the real 15-failure report: 15 proposals, 0 authorized, each validate_task() reporting the two things an author must supply (explicit authorization + write_paths).

autonomy_hardening_20261103.why_not_auto_dispatched: a node id is not a write scope; guessing the owning source file from a traceback is how an autonomous loop edits the wrong file or the test that grades it. Turning this step autonomous needs an evaluator, not more steps: candidate patches scored against the failing test + the regression suite + agent_kernel/content.py + a steward/reviewer verdict from a separate session, with best-of-N selection.
